note: The first input byte permits up to fifteen NUL-delimited argv strings, enough to encode repeated metaflac shorthand options.
Each --remove-replay-gain option appends five shorthand remove operations to the options->ops.operations array.
parse_options saves a pointer into options->ops.operations for the import-cuesheet operation before it may append another operation.
When more than fifty operations are present, appending OP__ADD_SEEKPOINT reallocates the operations array and can free the storage that op still points into.
The stale op pointer is dereferenced for a four- or pointer-width write into the freed operations allocation.
